independence: No selected audio was downloaded, played, decoded or scored in this project before the freeze. Titles and SHA-1s are disjoint from local external audio, local microphone recordings and study 05's reserved recordings. Credited authors are disjoint from earlier source credits, study 02 and study 05, and unique within this list. These are provenance checks based on cached metadata, not proof of independent capture events or representative real-world performance. The shared metadata search with study 05 is disclosed; no audio or outcome is shared. Files with no reference tones remain in the boost and whole-band scores, as required by the existing scoring code.
how_chosen: Selected on 20 Oct 2026 from the already-local 19 Oct Commons metadata cache results-tone-forecaster-05/fresh-metadata/commons_search02.json; no new web request or audio download. Eligibility: 10-150 seconds, no more than 25 MB per file, a recorded free-licence label, identifiable physical machinery, a distinct credited author for each recording, no previously used title/author and no study-05 reserved title/author, and no Work With Sounds collection. Eight files were selected to match studies 02/05 in sample count and cover appliances, a lift and transport machinery. Office/appliance captures are accompanied by an explicit start-up and a mixed engine/bird scene as gating stress cases. This is a purposive metadata sample, not random sampling. Music, speech, generated noise and unidentified ambient recordings were excluded. No outcome or measured spectrum was used in selection. Tonality, operating state, sound quality and usable in-band tones remain unknown.
compatibility_note: This object is supplied explicitly to freeze_protocol(fresh_list=...). fresh_recordings.json is an identical bare recordings list for frozen study 05's overlap guard. Do not feed that bare list to study 04's default freeze input.
